contact_addresses_area_pair.name: contact_addresses_area_pair
contact_addresses_area_pair.value:
(destination_area_id IS NULL AND destination_area_label IS NULL)
        OR (
          char_length(btrim(destination_area_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
          AND char_length(btrim(destination_area_label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
        )

ledger_entries_type_class_valid.name: ledger_entries_type_class_valid
ledger_entries_type_class_valid.value:
(entry_type IN (
          'COD_PRINCIPAL_COLLECTABLE',
          'COD_SERVICE_FEE_VAT_PAYABLE',
          'COD_REMITTANCE'
        ) AND financial_class = 'LIABILITY')
        OR (entry_type IN (
          'MENGANTAR_SHIPPING_COST',
          'MENGANTAR_INSURANCE_COST'
        ) AND financial_class = 'EXPENSE')
        OR (
          entry_type = 'GERAICUAN_COD_SERVICE_FEE_REVENUE'
          AND financial_class = 'REVENUE'
        )
        OR (
          entry_type IN ('NON_COD_UPSTREAM_PAYMENT', 'RECONCILIATION')
          AND financial_class = 'MEMO'
        )
        OR entry_type = 'ADJUSTMENT'

ledger_entries_source_event_valid.name: ledger_entries_source_event_valid
ledger_entries_source_event_valid.value:
(
          source_event = 'PROVIDER_ORDER_ISSUED'
          AND entry_type IN (
            'COD_PRINCIPAL_COLLECTABLE',
            'MENGANTAR_SHIPPING_COST',
            'MENGANTAR_INSURANCE_COST',
            'GERAICUAN_COD_SERVICE_FEE_REVENUE',
            'COD_SERVICE_FEE_VAT_PAYABLE'
          )
        )
        OR (
          source_event = 'UNPAID_RECOVERY_COMPLETED'
          AND entry_type IN (
            'MENGANTAR_SHIPPING_COST',
            'MENGANTAR_INSURANCE_COST',
            'NON_COD_UPSTREAM_PAYMENT'
          )
        )
        OR (
          source_event = 'COD_REMITTANCE_CONFIRMED'
          AND entry_type = 'COD_REMITTANCE'
        )
        OR (
          source_event = 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT'
          AND entry_type = 'ADJUSTMENT'
        )
        OR (
          source_event = 'RECONCILIATION_CLOSED'
          AND entry_type = 'RECONCILIATION'
        )

ledger_entries_actor_valid.name: ledger_entries_actor_valid
ledger_entries_actor_valid.value:
(actor_type = 'USER' AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (actor_type = 'SYSTEM' AND actor_user_id IS NULL)

ledger_entries_source_link_valid.name: ledger_entries_source_link_valid
ledger_entries_source_link_valid.value:
(
          entry_type = 'RECONCILIATION'
          AND reconciliation_run_id IS NOT NULL
          AND shipment_id IS NULL
          AND provider_batch_id IS NULL
          AND provider_order_snapshot_id IS NULL
          AND reverses_entry_id IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          entry_type = 'ADJUSTMENT'
          AND reconciliation_run_id IS NULL
          AND shipment_id IS NOT NULL
          AND provider_batch_id IS NOT NULL
          AND provider_order_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
          AND reverses_entry_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR (
          entry_type NOT IN ('ADJUSTMENT', 'RECONCILIATION')
          AND reconciliation_run_id IS NULL
          AND shipment_id IS NOT NULL
          AND provider_batch_id IS NOT NULL
          AND provider_order_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
          AND reverses_entry_id IS NULL
        )

print_events_printed_state_valid.name: print_events_printed_state_valid
print_events_printed_state_valid.value:
(
        outcome = 'PRINTED'
        AND sequence > 0
        AND char_length(btrim(awb_snapshot)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
        AND reason_code IS NULL
      ) OR (
        outcome = 'BLOCKED'
        AND sequence IS NULL
        AND awb_snapshot IS NULL
        AND char_length(btrim(reason_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40
      )

provider_batches_attempt_state_valid.name: provider_batches_attempt_state_valid
provider_batches_attempt_state_valid.value:
(status = 'SUBMISSION_QUEUED' AND submission_attempted_at IS NULL)
        OR (status <> 'SUBMISSION_QUEUED' AND submission_attempted_at IS NOT NULL)

provider_batches_completion_state_valid.name: provider_batches_completion_state_valid
provider_batches_completion_state_valid.value:
(status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND completed_at IS NULL)

provider_batches_safe_error_code_valid.name: provider_batches_safe_error_code_valid
provider_batches_safe_error_code_valid.value:
safe_error_code IS NULL
        OR char_length(btrim(safe_error_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

provider_order_snapshots_cod_amount_vali.name: provider_order_snapshots_cod_amount_valid
provider_order_snapshots_cod_amount_vali.value:
(is_cod AND provider_cod_amount_idr > 0)
        OR (NOT is_cod AND provider_cod_amount_idr IS NULL)

provider_order_snapshots_cnote_authority.name: provider_order_snapshots_cnote_authority
provider_order_snapshots_cnote_authority.value:
(status = 'ISSUED' AND char_length(btrim(cnote_no)) > 0)
        OR (status <> 'ISSUED' AND cnote_no IS NULL)

provider_order_snapshots_unpaid_state_va.name: provider_order_snapshots_unpaid_state_valid
provider_order_snapshots_unpaid_state_va.value:
status <> 'AWAITING_UPSTREAM_PAYMENT'
        OR (NOT is_cod AND is_paid = false AND cnote_no IS NULL)

provider_order_snapshots_resolved_state_.name: provider_order_snapshots_resolved_state_valid
provider_order_snapshots_resolved_state_.value:
(status = 'SUBMISSION_QUEUED' AND resolved_at IS NULL)
        OR (status <> 'SUBMISSION_QUEUED' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)

provider_order_snapshots_provider_order_.name: provider_order_snapshots_provider_order_id_valid
provider_order_snapshots_provider_order_.value:
provider_order_id IS NULL
        OR char_length(btrim(provider_order_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160

provider_order_snapshots_safe_response_c.name: provider_order_snapshots_safe_response_code_valid
provider_order_snapshots_safe_response_c.value:
safe_response_code IS NULL
        OR char_length(btrim(safe_response_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

provider_unpaid_recoveries_attempt_state.name: provider_unpaid_recoveries_attempt_state_valid
provider_unpaid_recoveries_attempt_state.value:
(status = 'PAYMENT_QUEUED' AND attempted_at IS NULL)
        OR (status <> 'PAYMENT_QUEUED' AND attempted_at IS NOT NULL)

provider_unpaid_recoveries_completion_st.name: provider_unpaid_recoveries_completion_state_valid
provider_unpaid_recoveries_completion_st.value:
(status IN ('PAYMENT_UNKNOWN', 'COMPLETED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status NOT IN ('PAYMENT_UNKNOWN', 'COMPLETED') AND completed_at IS NULL)

provider_unpaid_recoveries_response_stat.name: provider_unpaid_recoveries_response_state_valid
provider_unpaid_recoveries_response_stat.value:
(status IN ('PAYMENT_QUEUED', 'PAYING') AND safe_response_code IS NULL)
        OR (
          status = 'PAYMENT_UNKNOWN'
          AND char_length(btrim(safe_response_code)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        )
        OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND safe_response_code = 'PAY_UNPAID_ACCEPTED')

shipment_drafts_package_dimensions_valid.name: shipment_drafts_package_dimensions_valid
shipment_drafts_package_dimensions_valid.value:
(package_length_cm IS NULL AND package_width_cm IS NULL AND package_height_cm IS NULL)
        OR (package_length_cm > 0 AND package_width_cm > 0 AND package_height_cm > 0)

shipment_estimate_services_insurance_pai.name: shipment_estimate_services_insurance_pair
shipment_estimate_services_insurance_pai.value:
(insurance_amount_idr IS NULL AND insurance_source_field IS NULL)
        OR (
          insurance_amount_idr >= 0
          AND char_length(btrim(insurance_source_field)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        )
